title: hypixel skyblock endstone protector timer
description: timer for hypixel skyblock endstone protector
body:
This is my mod for hypixel skyblock:
It has one feature:

**when endstone protector is at it's last stage (about to be summoned) a subtle but visible timer starts being logged into the chat, when it reaches zero the endstone protector will spawn.
The text will turn green at exactly 6.5 seconds which is so you can shoot up and buffer arrows with ur term at perfect timing**

if you have issues or questions you can let me know on my youtube channel under latest video:
https://youtu.be/8smoFRiJNaM?si=eXWlvLFIRSrlyNnd
